## Fix pushed — Gerrit change 2442; RED→GREEN + Step 7 sweep

**Fix.** `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`: new `MATERIALIZER_PATHS='infra/scripts/compose-up.sh infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh infra/nginx/mcp-upstream.conf'` + a detect-only block emitting `err nginx_materializer_manual "…"`, mirroring the `EDGE_PATHS`/`nginx_edge_manual` block exactly. All four sources are now enumerated (AC#1). Detect-and-signal ONLY — no `nginx -s reload`/`nginx -t`/render/apply/rollback (AC#2; ADR 0079 v1→v2 boundary, apply owned by epic 6d60). `compose-up.sh` is enumerated for signal parity only (the loop must never re-run it — it brings up the Gerrit container).

**RED→GREEN test** (AC#3): `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_materializer.py`, parametrized over all four sources, mirroring `test_autodeploy_signals_nginx_edge.py`. Legitimately RED first (4/4 failed: no `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR`, deploy-complete on stdout), GREEN after fix (4/4). **Mutation-teeth** (sandboxed via `sandbox-exec`): emptying `MATERIALIZER_PATHS` — re-introducing the exact omission — returned all 4 to RED; restoring the fix → GREEN. Asserts on the observable emitted marker (stderr `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR {json}`), not internal names → not a change-detector.

**Fix-safety.** Restoration not creation (restores story 8903's reflect-main/signal-drift invariant, mirrors the accepted EDGE/CONFIG pattern; no new entry point/CLI/mutating call). No new dependency (pure bash). No existing test weakened (only a new test added). `observability.sh:232` already counts every `^AUTODEPLOY_ERROR \{` into `deploy_errors` regardless of reason (portable journalctl+grep, no CI dep) → no observability change. Full `tests/scripts` suite: 1311 passed, 3 skipped. `make lint` (incl. shellcheck on autodeploy.sh) passes. Confined to `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` + the new test — stayed out of eb64-declared scope.

**Replication.** Drove the real `autodeploy.sh` (report's own repro) with a git stub where only `materialize-opcert-guard.sh` changed: pre-fix → silent (rc=0, deploy-complete, empty stderr); post-fix → emits `AUTODEPLOY_ERROR reason=nginx_materializer_manual` naming the file. Original report no longer reproduces.

**Step 7 sweep.**
- *Axis 1 (construct — "source affects running env but absent from every autodeploy manifest").* 2 confirmed siblings, both **adjacent surfaces with distinct dispositions**, filed + linked `discovered_from` rather than folded into this detect-only fix:
  - `broke-choleric-hound` (5d4c-a25b-b612-4aca) — `infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh` is baked into the MCP image (`Dockerfile.mcp` `COPY . /app` + install as ENTRYPOINT) but absent from `MCP_PATHS`; a change never rebuilds the image → stale entrypoint. Disposition = **apply** (add to `MCP_PATHS`, an image rebuild inside mcp v1 scope), not detect-only.
  - `sunbeamy-uber-polliwog` (408c-9c78-c523-4d1c) — `infra/gerrit/materialize-deploy-key.sh` (SSM→file gerrit deploy-key materializer, sibling of `materialize-g2p-config.sh` which IS in `CONFIG_PATHS`) is in no manifest. Disposition = **detect-only parity** (add to `CONFIG_PATHS`).
  - Non-siblings (semantically excluded): `bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh` (one-time manual bootstrap, no invoker), `config-check.sh` (side-effect-free CI enumeration), `install-autodeploy.sh` (deliberately excluded, documented), `autodeploy.sh` (loop body, rsynced+re-exec'd).
- *Axis 2 (parity across channels).* N/A — the autodeploy loop is a single infra surface (one systemd oneshot); no parallel CLI/MCP/library channel performs this operation, no dual-direction mirror. No MISSING slots.

**Residual risk & prevention.** The two Axis-1 siblings are the only observed fragilities of this class; both are ticketed above. No structural construct-uniqueness guard exists to fail CI when a new host-affecting source is added outside a manifest — noted as a possible future guard, not filed (accepted: low churn, the three detect-only precedents now document the pattern).

**Attribution.** Scope-of-work omission → story **8903-efb2-b73f-4e22** (reflect-main invariant); recorded via the ungated `--caused-by=8903-efb2-b73f-4e22` flag on close (not a forced link). Close class: `plan_defect`.

Awaiting `LLM-Review +1` AND `Verified +1` on change 2442 before Submit + close.
